title: intentd started without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR sees no Claude session, so the estate page marks every running slot ORPHANED
body:
**AN intentd STARTED WITHOUT `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` SEES NO CLAUDE SESSION, AND THE ESTATE PAGE MARKS EVERY RUNNING SLOT ORPHANED.**

**Observed by devbin-vc on rhadamanth on 2026-11-01, and relayed to intent-vc the same morning.** The estate page, which intentd serves, marked every running slot ORPHANED, while the CLI's census, `intent estate status`, saw every session. devbin-vc's reading: intentd "runs without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and so sees no Claude sessions".

**Measured by intent-vc on rhadamanth on 2026-11-01.** The running intentd was pid 62625, `/opt/homebrew/bin/intentd` (brew 3.2.8), up 2:19:08 at 08:37:36Z by date -u, so started near 06:18Z. Its environment carried `HOME` and no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. On this machine `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is `~/.config/claude` and `~/.claude` does not exist. At 08:39:21Z the CLI's census listed 24 sessions. `intent estate status --daemon` refuses, because no daemon answers that verb, so the daemon's own view was read only through the page.

**Where it comes from.** `userstate::claude_dir` (`native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/userstate.rs`) takes the Claude directory from the process's own `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and falls back to `$HOME/.claude` (issue 0604), and intentd inherits whatever environment started it. The LaunchAgent plist that `intent daemon start --at-login` writes (`launchagent::write_plist`) sets `ProgramArguments` and no `EnvironmentVariables`, so a daemon that launchd starts at login has the same blind spot on any machine that sets `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. devbin-vc's words: "decision 98's at-login enrolment must carry that variable".

**Recorded only.** hv's word for 2026-11-01, relayed by devbin-vc, is "ship ST0011, no new code and no new yaks", so this records the finding and proposes no fix shape.

**Measured by intent-vc on 2026-11-01, 10:16Z to 10:19Z by date -u, after hv asked why the page keeps saying ORPHANED.** The intentd that started at 06:18:28Z (pid 62625, `/opt/homebrew/bin/intentd`) was parented to launchd, and its environment carried no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`. `launchctl getenv CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` by then read `~/.config/claude`, so whatever started that daemon started it without the variable. The menubar app that was running (pid 8368, a Debug build from `~/.local/state/intent/build/macos`, up since 2026-10-31 21:32Z) carried none either. It starts, stops and restarts the daemon through `IntentCLI`, whose `environment()` takes `PATH` from the login shell but not `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (`native/macos/Intent/Intent/Services/IntentCLI.swift`, `DaemonService.swift`). Which process started that daemon is not proven. hv ran `intent daemon restart` from intent-vc's shell, which carries the variable, and the new intentd (pid 1729) carried it too. Asked through the page's own `/op` call at 10:18:58Z, it saw 24 sessions, none gone, and none of the 1 held slot was ORPHANED. So the lasting fix has two halves: the app passes `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` as it passes `PATH`, and the plist `daemon start --at-login` writes sets it.

**Ruled by hv on 2026-11-01, first-hand in intent-vc's session, read by 10:21Z on intent-vc's date -u: the lasting fix is an obvious bug fix, not new code, and is built now.** hv, verbatim: "This can be done now." and "That's not 'net new code'. That's fixing an obvious bug. Fixing obvious bugs is what this release needs." (vc decision 106). That lifted the "Recorded only" above.

**Banked, and it rides 3.3.0.** hv ruled on 2026-11-10 that one release, 3.3.0, carries everything outstanding and that there is no 3.2.9 (vc decision 109). intent-cc's fix is banked at `refs/bank/cc/0671/fix-v1` (patch-id cb974be96777), with its run script at `refs/bank/cc/0671/run-v1.sh`. Intent.app takes `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` from the login shell as it takes `PATH` and hands it to every child, the plist that `daemon start --at-login` writes carries it, and intentd's boot-time heal of that plist keeps it. intent-vc's read of the bank found nothing against it, and its judged run is part of 3.3.0's first train. Recorded by intent-vc on 2026-11-10.

**Landed in c2d1711004e7 on intent-vc's word, and closed by intent-cc on 2026-11-10.** It lands from `refs/bank/cc/0671/fix-v2` (blob 46b6cd199371, patch-id e5fb029d7ebf, base fe748602e), which is fix-v1 with its one red fixed: launchagent's unit test wrote 3.2.8 as another build's stamp on a 3.2.8 build, and now derives that stamp from the build's own version. intent-vc's evidence: the whole suite on v1, stacked on main at 1dcd8928f993 (`refs/bank/vc/train1/judge-v1.stamps`); v2 against v1, one hunk in one test (`refs/bank/vc/0671/judge-v2.interdiff.patch`); launchagent's tests green on v2 (`refs/bank/vc/0671/judge-v2.stamps`); and the three new daemon_lifecycle arms red at the base, each on the assertion that names this defect (`refs/bank/vc/0671/judge-red.stamps`). intent-cc's probe read the login shell's `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` under `env -i` on rhadamanth, and none under a HOME with no `.zshenv` (`refs/bank/cc/0671/run-v4-stamps.txt`). The commit's patch-id read back e5fb029d7ebf, and each of its nine paths reads the same blob as vc's judged tree c02e08121f81. The fix reaches a machine at the 3.3.0 cut. There, a daemon Intent.app starts gets the value from the app's login-shell probe, and a plist already enrolled gains it at the next `intent daemon start --at-login` run from a shell that sets it.
